text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Happy birthday to you too, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if it's my birthday, it's not 
like it's anything special. Making a big 
fuss just isn't my style anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, are we talking about me? Is today 
a special day for you, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, as a milestone, it certainly 
brings a different feeling than usual.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Besides... sharing a birthday with 
Nature-san makes it feel extra special, 
and I'm really happy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You're happy just being with me? 
I'd get it if I were a celebrity or 
something, though.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san is someone with so much I can 
learn from. Sharing a birthday with 
someone like her makes me feel so proud...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaah! Cut it out with the embarrassing 
stuff already! Alright, that's enough of 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, since it's your birthday and all, 
let's cut loose together just for today.
